title: There is / There are
subtitle: Есть, находится: there is a book on the table

theory.text: Когда говорим, что где-то что-то есть, используем there is (ед. число) и there are (мн. число). Место обычно ставится в конец: There is a book on the table.
Русское «В комнате есть стол» переводим с конца: There is a table in the room.

en: There is a table in the room.
There are many parks in the city.
There are a lot of parks in the city.
Is there a book on the table?
There is no milk in the fridge.
There isn't any milk in the fridge.
There was a shop here.
There was a store here.
There will be a concert there.
How many rooms are there in the house?
There were children in the park.
There is nobody here.
There is no one here.
There isn't anybody here.
Is there a museum in our city?
Is there a museum in our town?
There are no pictures in this book.
There is an apple in the bag.
There are two pictures on the wall.
Is there a park near the house?
There are no students in the classroom.
There aren't any students in the classroom.
There were many people here yesterday.
There were a lot of people here yesterday.
Will there be a lesson tomorrow?
There is a cafe in our street.
There is a cafe on our street.
How many students are there in the group?

items.ru: В комнате было темно и не было окон.
en: It was dark in the room and there were no windows.
